item.name: Retrieves a usage consumption summary of a subscriber

request.name: Retrieves a usage consumption summary of a subscriber

description.content: This operation is used to retrieve usage consumption summary/report of a subscriber.

query.description: Type of usage concerned by the bucket, such as voice, sms, data
Identifies the source system which integrates with MAD API
Query mode for which the request is to be returned, pass 0 or this will be assisgned a default value(0)
